payload.title: Performance benchmarking & load harness
payload.description: No benchmarking/load infra exists. From hardening spec (1220-1268): benchmarks for latency (HTTP, WS, append round-trip, catch-up, reconnect), throughput, memory/db/cache growth, codec speed (TS/Swift/Kotlin), projection rebuilds, job throughput; plus a load harness with synthetic data, configurable params, JSON output for trend tracking, and initial performance budgets. Size: M.
